title: Unit – 4 : Session – 11 : SLO – 1  |  UDP Socket Behaviour
sections: 1. UDP does not guarantee reliable or ordered delivery (packets may be lost, duplicated or arrive out of order).
2. sendto() is used to send data along with a destination address (host, port) — UDP has no connection to default to.
1. b) Unreliable and fast — UDP trades reliability for minimal overhead and low latency.
